questions.text: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, how many days do they take, rounded to two decimals?
questions.explain: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so the job takes 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.text: A price is increased by 20 percent and the result is then decreased by 20 percent. What is the net percentage change, as a signed number?
questions.explain: The multiplier is 1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96, a 4 percent decrease. Successive percentage changes multiply rather than add.

questions.text: A train 200 m long travelling at 72 km/h crosses a platform 250 m long. How many seconds does it take?
questions.explain: 72 km/h = 20 m/s. Distance covered is train plus platform = 450 m, so time = 450 / 20 = 22.5 s.

questions.text: All engineers are problem solvers. Some problem solvers are artists. Which conclusion necessarily follows?
options: No valid conclusion links engineers and artists
questions.explain: The overlap between problem solvers and artists need not include any engineer. Neither an affirmative nor a negative link between engineers and artists is forced.

questions.text: In a group of 100 people, 60 read English newspapers, 45 read Hindi newspapers and 20 read both. How many read neither?
questions.explain: Inclusion-exclusion: 60 + 45 - 20 = 85 read at least one, so 100 - 85 = 15 read neither.

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'ephemeral'.
questions.explain: Ephemeral means short-lived, so its antonym is enduring. Transient is a synonym, not an antonym.

options: Neither of the two answers are correct.
Neither of the two answers is correct.
Neither of the two answer are correct.
Neither of the two answers were correct.
questions.explain: 'Neither' is singular, so it takes a singular verb: 'is'. The plural noun in the prepositional phrase does not govern the verb.

questions.text: A solid cube of side 4 cm is painted on all faces and then cut into 1 cm cubes. How many of the small cubes have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explain: Exactly two faces painted means the cube sits along an edge but not at a corner. Each of the 12 edges contributes n - 2 = 2 such cubes, giving 12 x 2 = 24.
